\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 192-195 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R200-first-pass-words-from-chapters-192-195}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a wound and health.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to ride, to pay; to push, to save, to receive, to cost
  \item to take off, to try, to measure, to bargain, to go shopping
  \item to swallow, to chew, to touch, to smell, to hold
  \item to resign, to manage, to meet, to get lost, to show the way
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To ride? (\textbf{\ar{ركب}}, \emph{rakiba}.) To pay; to push? (\textbf{\ar{دفع}}, \emph{dafaʿa}.) To save? (\textbf{\ar{وفر}}, \emph{waffara}.) To receive? (\textbf{\ar{استلم}}, \emph{istalama}.) To cost? (\textbf{\ar{كلف}}, \emph{kallafa}.) To take off? (\textbf{\ar{خلع}}, \emph{khalaʿa}.) To try? (\textbf{\ar{جرب}}, \emph{jarraba}.) To measure? (\textbf{\ar{قاس}}, \emph{qāsa}.) To bargain? (\textbf{\ar{ساوم}}, \emph{sāwama}.) To go shopping? (\textbf{\ar{تسوق}}, \emph{tasawwaqa}.) To swallow? (\textbf{\ar{ابتلع}}, \emph{ibtalaʿa}.) To chew? (\textbf{\ar{مضغ}}, \emph{maḍagha}.) To touch? (\textbf{\ar{لمس}}, \emph{lamasa}.) To smell? (\textbf{\ar{شم}}, \emph{shamma}.) To hold? (\textbf{\ar{أمسك}}, \emph{amsaka}.) To resign? (\textbf{\ar{استقال}}, \emph{istaqāla}.) To manage? (\textbf{\ar{أدار}}, \emph{adāra}.) To meet? (\textbf{\ar{قابل}}, \emph{qābala}.) To get lost? (\textbf{\ar{ضل}}, \emph{ḍalla}.) To show the way? (\textbf{\ar{دل}}, \emph{dalla}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 196-200 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:AR-R200-second-pass-words-from-chapters-196-200}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to plant and to pick.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to plant, to pick, to rain, to congratulate, to trust
  \item to discuss, to compare, to notice, to pay attention, to consider
  \item to allow, to prevent, to happen, to fall, to dig
  \item to shake, to bite, to blow, to whisper, to harvest
  \item a cold, a cough, an allergy, a wound, health
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To plant? (\textbf{\ar{زرع}}, \emph{zaraʿa}.) To pick? (\textbf{\ar{قطف}}, \emph{qaṭafa}.) To rain? (\textbf{\ar{أمطر}}, \emph{amṭara}.) To congratulate? (\textbf{\ar{هنأ}}, \emph{hannaʾa}.) To trust? (\textbf{\ar{وثق}}, \emph{wathiqa}.) To discuss? (\textbf{\ar{ناقش}}, \emph{nāqasha}.) To compare? (\textbf{\ar{قارن}}, \emph{qārana}.) To notice? (\textbf{\ar{لاحظ}}, \emph{lāḥaẓa}.) To pay attention? (\textbf{\ar{انتبه}}, \emph{intabaha}.) To consider? (\textbf{\ar{اعتبر}}, \emph{iʿtabara}.) To allow? (\textbf{\ar{سمح}}, \emph{samaḥa}.) To prevent? (\textbf{\ar{منع}}, \emph{manaʿa}.) To happen? (\textbf{\ar{حدث}}, \emph{ḥadatha}.) To fall? (\textbf{\ar{سقط}}, \emph{saqaṭa}.) To dig? (\textbf{\ar{حفر}}, \emph{ḥafara}.) To shake? (\textbf{\ar{هز}}, \emph{hazza}.) To bite? (\textbf{\ar{عض}}, \emph{ʿaḍḍa}.) To blow? (\textbf{\ar{نفخ}}, \emph{nafakha}.) To whisper? (\textbf{\ar{همس}}, \emph{hamasa}.) To harvest? (\textbf{\ar{حصد}}, \emph{ḥaṣada}.) A cold? (\textbf{\ar{زكام}}, \emph{zukām}.) A cough? (\textbf{\ar{سعال}}, \emph{suʿāl}.) An allergy? (\textbf{\ar{حساسية}}, \emph{ḥassāsiyya}.) A wound? (\textbf{\ar{جرح}}, \emph{jurḥ}.) Health? (\textbf{\ar{صحة}}, \emph{ṣiḥḥa}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
